values.note: Run directly by the Forest Service (Huron Shores Ranger District), not a concessionaire. Every site is reserved by number on recreation.gov April 15 - November 30; December 1 - April 14 no permit or reservation is required. Occupy the site within 24 hours of the reservation's start or it is forfeit unless the Forest Service approves a late arrival. 14 nights in any 30 days.

note: Six drive-in sites strung over about 1.5 km below Alcona Dam Pond; pick 001D, 002D, 003D or 006D (26 ft) for a 23-ft rig. Part of the AuSable River Dispersed Camping system: 102 designated sites along 55 miles of the lower AuSable in the Huron NF, booked as one recreation.gov facility. Dirt or gravel parking aprons; the sites sit on bluffs 5-300 ft above the river and access to the water can be steep. Equipment within 25 ft of the site post; two vehicles and two camping units per site. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + per-site catalog + FS page: FS-run (Huron Shores RD), $10 Apr 15 - Nov 30 (confirmed), free and no permit Dec 1 - Apr 14, 50% Senior/Access on one site (stated). Six drive-in back-in sites at the pin (four to 26 ft, two 18 ft) - a 23-ft motorhome has four to drive to; 005C in the same section is a tent-only boat-in. Added max_rig_ft 26, no pull-through, no water/sewer, 14-night limit, URL; season derived opens 04-15 -> year-round (not maintained Dec 1 - Apr 14). Current Huron-Manistee alerts (April 2026 flooding, March 2026 winter storm, Iargo Springs closure) name no AuSable River campsite or road near it; the standing 'Au Sable National Scenic River Camping Restrictions' order only confines camping to designated sites. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
